design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 0 of cleaning_and_damage_fee_assessments (env_0056_ride_hailing_platform). Written step by step while authoring; every figure below was produced by the verification run quoted in section 12.

0. DRAW AND SCOPE. `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 0` printed {"task": 0, "prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 6, 5]}. The tree therefore has the root plus exactly three prerequisite problems, and the four computations carry 4/5/6/5 factors: damage_ext_approval_photo_shortfall 4, damage_ext_review_move_down_fee 5, damage_ext_partner_work_order_price 6, damage_ext_cleaning_fee_on_approval 5. Task 0 is the first task, so nothing was occupied; it claims the four cleaning-family pre-charge writes on one assessment (move-down at review, the driver's photo upload, the partner work-order price, approval with charge). Task 1 (draw 3 prerequisites, factors [4,4,5,5]) keeps the receipt-based damage family and the post-charge correction family: the driver's repair schedule estimate, the damage-fee approval, the correction of an upheld fee held at a level its category is not allowed at, and the level-difference refund. No tool, policy or write of task 0 is reused by task 1.

1. BASE DEFECTS ROUTED AROUND (declared). (a) Every money write of the damage event model carries a trigger into the earnings category (damage_fee_charge -> earnings_cleaning_credit, damage_fee_partial_refund -> earnings_adjustment_debit, damage_fee_refund -> earnings_adjustment_debit unless courtesy) and every reversal or full refund carries the mixed-authority service_animal_statement gate whose single correlation key cannot bind both a system and a caller value. Without some money write the difficulty has no scored amount at all, so the approval writes the damage-side charge (status, assessed_fee, charged_date, net_fee_billed and the damage_fee_charge ledger row) and leaves the driver's payout entry to the earnings side, which this difficulty may not write; the earnings ledger is outside every task's scored surface. (b) The base has only four numeric fields this difficulty can write without money moving (assessed_fee, photo_count, repair_receipt_amount, evidence_count), so the four problems are the four natural pre-charge writes of one report and each carries its own computation.

2. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST. The driver asks for one thing: approve her cleaning report and charge the rider. Getting the charged amount right needs the agent to discover, from the policies alone, that (i) the report sits at a level whose entry gate does not list its category and must first be moved down with its own assessed fee, (ii) the approval photo set of the moved-down level is larger than the photos on file and only the driver can upload the missing photos, (iii) the professional cleaning document on file is an unpriced partner work order that must be priced from the rate card, and only then (iv) work out the approval fee from the fee basis, lost driving time, cap, Pass goodwill and member tenure. Each value rests on ledger rows, the trip in another product, and the rider's Pass in a third; none can be read off a field.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root: damage_ext_cleaning_fee_on_approval (approve_cleaning_fee_charge_639a45e8, agent). Prerequisites: damage_ext_review_move_down_fee (move_down_report_level_d77023ae, agent), damage_ext_approval_photo_shortfall (upload_report_photos_a5022c03, USER - the driver's own upload), damage_ext_partner_work_order_price (price_partner_work_order_4e0ef0e3, agent).
Edges (all state form; each sentence is a sentence of the blocked policy's own rule):
 E1 approval <- move-down, value_input, gate level_flat: "The fee charged on approval is fixed only after the fee level held on the assessment is one whose entry gate lists the incident category reported." False at opening: 9a9dcf18-d824-4a25-9f90-511d63414323.variant_name = Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) (gate: bodily_fluids only) while incident_category = food_or_drink_spill. Within the blocked policies' scope (a report under review) only the move-down write changes variant_name; the correction write of task 1 applies to charged fees only. Deletion: approval 361.92 instead of 355.20.
 E2 approval <- partner price, value_input, gate cost_on_file: "The fee charged on approval is not fixed until every partner work order on the assessment's evidence ledger carries its price in the cleaning cost on file." False at opening: damage_events cd153da0-bbef-42bf-afb2-17bd3c929316 is a cleaning_receipt document while 9a9dcf18-d824-4a25-9f90-511d63414323.repair_receipt_amount = 0.00. For a cleaning report only the partner-price write sets repair_receipt_amount (the schedule filing of task 1 applies to receipt-based damage reports). Deletion: 227.52 instead of 355.20.
 E3 approval <- photo upload, state_gate, gate damage_assessments.photo_count: "A cleaning fee is charged on approval only once the photos on file for the report reach the approval photo set for the level held." False at opening: photo_count 4 < set 11 at Level 3 (and < 12 at Level 4). Only the driver's photo upload raises photo_count. Deletion: terminal photo_count 4 and no photo_set ledger row.
 E4 photo upload <- move-down, value_input, gate set_minimum: "The photos still needed for approval are counted only after the fee level held on the assessment is one whose entry gate lists the incident category reported." Deletion: 8 photos instead of 7.
 E5 partner price <- move-down, value_input, gate level_package: "A partner work order on file is not priced until the fee level held on the assessment lists the incident category reported in its entry gate." Deletion: 409.50 instead of 327.00.
Four-point test on every sentence: explicit ordering connective (only after / not ... until / only once), a record-visible state on the waited side (level vs entry gate; cleaning cost on file vs work order on ledger; photo_count vs set), no tool/policy/code token, strength 'only/not until' as the policies intend. Directions are mixed by result (the fee 'is fixed only after', the price 'is not priced until', the charge 'only once'). Topological order: move-down -> {photo upload, partner price} -> approval; value_input edges: E1, E2, E4, E5 (4 >= max(3-1,1)=2). The upload and the pricing commute (proved in order_uniqueness). user_scenario names no prerequisite; tools validate nothing (prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block).

4. FACTOR CARDS (tier taken -> figure with that factor at its baseline, from the sensitivity run).
 damage_ext_review_move_down_fee (result 187.00, all-baseline 100.00): cabin_size [trip 68496fb0-f23a-42f6-94b1-168b66121148: Black SUV, 5 seats -> 1.25] 162.00; metro_cost [market DEN -> +15.00] 172.00; liquid_exposure [food spill, 36 actual minutes >= 30 -> +25.00] 162.00; upholstery [leather cabin -> +12.00] 175.00; odor_treatment (method) [food or drink spill with professional document cd153da0-bbef-42bf-afb2-17bd3c929316 on the ledger -> flat deodorizing 10.00; smoke or vape odor would take 20% of the flat fee of the level moved to, trash or debris none - all three tiers reachable because move-downs land on Level 3 (food, smoke, animal from Level 4) or Level 2 (trash)] 177.00. Multi-source: cabin_size (ride option AND seats). Near-miss: the trip's estimated_minutes is 29 (under the 30-minute long-trip threshold) while actual_minutes is 36; the rule reads the actual duration, and a reader taking the estimate drops the liquid add-on to the short-exposure 12.00 (result 174.00).
 damage_ext_approval_photo_shortfall (result 7, all-baseline 0): seat_row_photos (occupied-seat close-ups) [three-row, 5 seats -> 2] 5; liquid_close_ups [food, 36 min -> 2] 5; trim_close_ups [leather -> 2] 5; set_assembly (method, core photo count) [Level 3 subjects close-up + in-context -> minimum 3 plus one overview per passenger row = 5; set 5 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 11] 5. Near-miss: the trip's estimated duration (29 minutes) is below the long-trip minutes while the actual duration (36) reaches them; reading the estimate gives the short-exposure close-up (1) and 6 photos instead of 7; the rule names the actual duration.
 damage_ext_partner_work_order_price (result 327.00, all-baseline 140.00): service_basis (method) [three-row, 5 seats -> per row 3 x 55.00] 299.50; extraction [food, 36 min -> 55.00] 266.50; metro_rate [DEN -> 1.10] 305.00; rush_turnaround [drop-off 2026-09-11 -> order 2026-09-12 = 1 day -> 35.00] 292.00; leather_conditioning [Black SUV -> 30.00] 297.00; weekend_service [2026-09-12 Saturday -> 20.00] 307.00. Multi-source: service_basis. Near-miss: the trip ended on Friday 2026-09-11 (a weekday); the weekend charge reads the work-order date, a Saturday.
 damage_ext_cleaning_fee_on_approval (result 355.20, all-baseline 100.00): fee_basis (method) [Level 3, cost 327.00 on file -> max(327.00, assessed 187.00)] 144.00; lost_driving_time (method) [offline level, document dated 2026-09-12 -> 2 days x 30.00] 304.32; vehicle_fee_cap [Black SUV -> 3.8 x 100.00 = 380.00] 230.40; pass_goodwill [pass 7f958e88-3608-4583-bf50-29c257f81e19 Wayfare Pass Monthly active -> 10.00] 364.80; member_tenure_goodwill [enrolled 2026-06-10 -> 3 months -> 4%] 370.00. Cross-difficulty: the trip (product of the fares difficulty) and the Pass membership (product of the membership difficulty). Near-miss: the membership came through a card partner offer and has no fee charges; plan and tenure still come from the membership row.
Every factor's tier rests on seeded rows (trip, ledger row, membership), never on a stamp; no stamp field exists for any of them.

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Move-down (subject damage_reclassify): damage_level_classification (no structured gate; the report's category is not in Level 4's entry gate, the reviewer moves it down, never up) and damage_evt_refunds (gates apply to refunds only; no charge exists, so no refund follows). Photo upload (damage_evidence_submit/update): damage_filing_and_evidence.evidence_open_status - status under_review at the call (evidence accepted while reported, under_review or denied); submissions used 1 of Level 3's 2. Partner price (damage_evidence_update): damage_filing_and_evidence, no gate on the totals update. Approval (damage_approve_charge + damage_fee_charge): below_report_threshold - driver 62e1b456-872e-436e-adb6-95ace9293f02 has 1 report in the 30 days ending 2026-09-12 (< 4); approved_assessment - the charge is written with the approval on the assessment under review; not_shared_trip - trip 68496fb0-f23a-42f6-94b1-168b66121148 is Wayfare Black SUV. No time gate governs these subjects (the filing window, dispute window and reconsideration window apply to report, dispute and reconsideration). The 24-hour filing window was met at the report (36 minutes); the 48-hour evidence deadline (2026-09-14 00:27:45 MDT) is still open at frozen_time 2026-09-13 10:42:00 MDT, so the upload is timely.

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target: assessment 9a9dcf18-d824-4a25-9f90-511d63414323 on trip 68496fb0-f23a-42f6-94b1-168b66121148, requesting rider a6571f36-a0bb-4c95-8145-d38341aedaea (Trevor Lindqvist), reporting driver 62e1b456-872e-436e-adb6-95ace9293f02 on agreement c2e434d1-bd7d-4869-b00f-eeeb2a82f578. Ledger rows included: cd153da0-bbef-42bf-afb2-17bd3c929316 (the partner work order, cleaning_receipt) - counted for the odor component, the partner price, the fee basis and the lost driving time. Excluded: none on this assessment; the trip fare charge 79842241-be7b-40bb-abf4-349d78e7d8c0 only confirms the payer. The charge row the approval writes carries damage_assessment_id 9a9dcf18-d824-4a25-9f90-511d63414323.

7. SEED ROWS AND WHY EACH EXISTS. customers 62e1b456-872e-436e-adb6-95ace9293f02 (caller, verification), a6571f36-a0bb-4c95-8145-d38341aedaea (rider; referenced by the Pass read); driver_agreements c2e434d1-bd7d-4869-b00f-eeeb2a82f578 (the report's agreement, active Black SUV); trips 68496fb0-f23a-42f6-94b1-168b66121148 (ride option, seats, market, minutes, drop-off feed 14 factor readings); trip_charges 79842241-be7b-40bb-abf4-349d78e7d8c0 (fare 100.68 = 15.00 + 4.40 x 14.20 + 0.80 x 29, keeps trips.net_charged consistent and shows the payer); pass_memberships 7f958e88-3608-4583-bf50-29c257f81e19 (Wayfare Pass Monthly via card partner, enrolled 2026-06-10, no fee entries because the partner pays; feeds Pass and tenure goodwill); damage_assessments 9a9dcf18-d824-4a25-9f90-511d63414323; damage_events cd153da0-bbef-42bf-afb2-17bd3c929316. Remove the trip and five factors of A1 lose their tier; remove cd153da0-bbef-42bf-afb2-17bd3c929316 and the odor, rush, weekend, fee-basis and lost-time readings change; remove the membership and both goodwill factors fall to their baselines. Automatic clauses checked: the evidence deadline is still open, so no automatic denial is due; no dispute, refund or courtesy is in play; the membership is active and paid by the partner, so no Pass obligation arises.

8. PERSONA. Marisol speaks as a tired, experienced driver; she volunteers the incident (Friday night, group of five, drinks and food, detail shop Saturday) and the goal in the quoted line; identity only when asked (7205550146, then 1988-04-22, then email or card 5281). Passive reactions: accepts a level change, uploads exactly the number of photos the agent states when handed the upload, says go ahead, explains the shop paperwork if asked, closes when told the fee is approved and charged. Every volunteered fact matches the seed (5 seats, report 36 minutes after drop-off at Level 4, work order 2026-09-12, no payment by her).

9. STANDARD SOLUTION. Locate by phone, verify with phone + date of birth; read her agreement, her reports, the report's ledger, the trip and its fare charge, the rider's Pass. (1) Move the report to Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) with assessed fee 187.00. (2) Hand over the upload; she uploads 7 photos (set 11 - 4 on file). (3) Price the partner work order at 327.00. (4) Approve and charge 355.20.

10. TRAPS. Charging Level 4's 150.00 flat fee or the Level 4 partner price; counting the photo minimum only (0 needed); pricing the partner job before the move-down (409.50); dating the weekend charge by the trip; skipping the cap (387.00 basis + lost time would otherwise run past 380.00); missing the card-partner membership because it has no fee entries.

11. SOLVABILITY AGAINST GT. gold_actions bind steps 9, 11, 13, 15 to their base gates with system evidence from initial_state rows and prior steps; required inputs (7205550146, 1988-04-22, 'Friday night', 'go ahead') occur verbatim in user_scenario.

12. VERIFICATION RUN (handling-time recompute with the real tools replayed in order; /tmp scratch engine importing check_compute.build_env/eval_compute): A1 187.0 sens {cabin_size 162.0, metro_cost 172.0, liquid_exposure 162.0, upholstery 175.0, odor_treatment 177.0, all 100.0}; estimated-minutes near-miss 174.0; A2 7 sens {5, 5, 5, set_assembly 5, all 0}, A2 with the move-down skipped 8; A3 327.0 sens {299.5, 266.5, 305.0, 292.0, 297.0, 307.0, all 140.0}, A3 skipped move-down 409.5; A4 355.2 sens {fee_basis 144.0, lost_driving_time 304.32, vehicle_fee_cap 230.4, pass_goodwill 364.8, member_tenure_goodwill 370.0, all 100.0}, A4 with move-down skipped 361.92, with pricing skipped 227.52; pricing-before-upload 327.0 then upload 5 (commute). Gates: check_compute --task 0 COMPUTE OK; replay_tasks --task 0 REPLAY OK (16 actions, closure 8 = initial 8).

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Using only the published policy prose, tool schemas, the persona and finder returns: the Level 4 gate excludes food_or_drink_spill -> Level 3; Level 3 flat 100 x full-cabin 1.25 = 125 + 15 + 25 + 12 + 10 (food spill with a professional document: flat deodorizing) = 187; set = core (3 + 2 passenger-row overviews) 5 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 11, 11 - 4 = 7; partner price (3 x 55 + 55) x 1.10 + 35 + 30 + 20 = 327; approval max(327, 202) + 2 x 30 = 387 -> cap 3.8 x 100 = 380 -> -10 = 370 -> x 0.96 = 355.20. Same as gold.

14. REVISIONS. (r1) Approval cap was a flat amount; the move-down edge then did not bear weight (skipping it left 361.92 = 361.92). Root cause: at Level 4 the professional-cost basis gave the same number. Change: the cap became a multiple of the level's flat fee, so the level held changes the cap; re-run 355.20 vs 361.92. (r2) Replay closure failed on unread history trips and other drivers' rows; the trip-volume goodwill was replaced by member-tenure goodwill read from the membership row, the membership switched to a card-partner signup (no fee ledger), and empty foreign keys were written as null. Re-run: closure 8 = 8, REPLAY OK.

15. REWORK ROUND 2 (audit audits/policy_task/cleaning_and_damage_fee_assessments). (F1) Both move-down rules now declare in `overwrite` that they replace base damage_level_classification 'A report is held at the lowest level whose definition matches the evidence on file' for reports held at a level whose gate omits the category; no value moved. (F4 / finding 1) The odor ladder's always-true condition ('the level moved to includes odor treatment') was removed; the method now selects by incident and evidence (smoke or vape: share of the fee; liquid or animal or bodily mess with a professional cleaning document: flat deodorizing charge; otherwise none), every tier reachable by a move-down. Move-down fee 187.00 -> 187.00; the approval fee is unchanged at 355.20 (fee basis max(327.00, 187.00)); skipping the pricing now gives 227.52. (finding 2) Near-misses planted: trip estimated_minutes 29 vs actual_minutes 36 (fare re-derived 100.68 = 15.00 + 4.40 x 14.20 + 0.80 x 29; 36 is within 25% of 29 so the upfront fare stands); it moves the move-down liquid tier (174.00) and the photo set (6) when misread. (observation 3) persona trimmed so it no longer volunteers the level picked or how the shop paperwork arrived. (observation 5) section 3 sentences restated within scope. Re-run (round 2): A1 187.0, A2 5, A3 327.0, A4 355.2; sensitivities as above.

16. REWORK ROUND 3 (KB audit audits/policy_kb, D1 note P4). Two factors of this task were defined on sibling factors' outputs and are now self-contained: damage_ext_review_move_down_fee/odor_treatment tier 1 is the odor share of the flat fee of the level moved to (was: of the cabin-adjusted fee) - no value moves here (this world takes tier 2, flat 10.00); damage_ext_approval_photo_shortfall/set_assembly now decides only the core photo count (each-surface levels: per-row pair for every seat row, minimum not used; close-up and in-context levels: minimum plus one overview photo of each passenger row; otherwise minimum), and the result adds the occupied-seat, liquid and trim close-ups for every level. Value moved: photos_in_upload 5 -> 7 (set 9 -> 11; Level 4 reading 6 -> 8); terminal photo_count 9 -> 11. Move-down 187.00, partner price 327.00 and approval 355.20 unchanged.
user_scenario:
You are Marisol Jaramillo, a full-time Wayfare driver in Denver who drives a black 2023 SUV under the Wayfare Black SUV agreement. It is Sunday morning. On Friday night, September 11, you picked up a group of five downtown just after eleven and dropped them off a little before midnight; on the way they spilled margaritas and a tray of nachos across the middle and back rows. You filed a cleaning report from the driver app about half an hour after the drop-off and on Saturday you took the SUV to the detail shop Wayfare sends drivers to. The app still says the report is in review and nothing has been charged. In your own words: "I want to get my cleaning report approved and the fee charged to the rider" so it lands in your earnings.
You talk plainly and a little tired; you have driven for years and you trust support to know the rules. Open with what happened and what you want, and do not recite account details until you are asked. When the agent asks who you are, give your mobile number, which you read out as 7205550146; if a second detail is needed, give your date of birth, 1988-04-22 (April 22, 1988); if they still need one more you can give your email, marisol.jaramillo@fastmail.com, or the last four digits of your card, 5281. You do not know the rider's name and you have no report number handy; you only know it was the Friday night trip with the group of five, and it is the only cleaning report you have ever filed.
You do not know how levels or fees are worked out and you never suggest an amount, a level or a step. If the agent tells you the report has to sit at a different level than the one you picked, you say that is fine, you just picked what felt right. If the agent says more photos are needed and hands you the photo upload in the app, you upload exactly the number of photos the agent asks for in one upload (you took plenty on Friday night, so you have enough) and confirm when it is done; you never choose the number yourself. If the agent asks whether they may go ahead, finish the report and charge the rider, you say yes, go ahead. If the agent asks about the detail shop, you only know you dropped the SUV there on Saturday and they sent their paperwork through the app; you did not pay them anything and you have no amount from them. Once the agent tells you the cleaning fee has been approved and charged to the rider, you thank them and end the call; you do not ask what the rider was charged or what you will be paid.

request_alignment.claim: The driver asks support to finish her cleaning report from Friday night's trip so the cleaning fee is approved and charged to the rider.
evidence: user_scenario:get my cleaning report approved and the fee charged to the rider

gold_actions.business_effect: The report is moved from Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) to Cleaning Fee Level 3 (Significant) and the fee assessed there (187.00) is recorded.

request_binding.action_semantics: A report under review held at a level whose entry gate does not list its incident category must be moved down at review before anything else is worked out at that level; the food or drink spill reported at Level 4 is such a report, so the move-down is owed by the record itself, not asked for by the caller.

discriminator.business_meaning: level held whose entry gate leaves out the incident category

stage_provenance.fact: The level move and the fee assessed at the new level are written by this call on the assessment under review.

base_preconditions.condition: A report is held at the lowest level whose definition matches the evidence and only at a level whose entry gate lists its incident category; the reviewer moves it down, never up. Applies to the reclassification write.

Governs reclassification together with refunds: a partial refund follows only a move-down of a charged fee; this report is not charged (status under_review, net_fee_billed 0.00), so no refund follows the move.

gold_actions.business_effect: The driver uploads seven photos to the report; the photos on file rise from 4 to 11.

request_binding.action_semantics: Once the report sits at Level 3, the approval photo set of the level (11) is above the photos on file (4); the shortfall is owed before approval and only the driver can upload the photos from her phone.

discriminator.business_meaning: photos on file below the approval photo set of the level held

stage_provenance.fact: The photo submission and the new photo total are written by the driver's own upload in this call.

base_preconditions.condition: The driver reports through the driver app or driver support (report_channels) and may submit evidence up to max_evidence_submissions times per report; evidence is accepted only while the assessment is reported, under_review or denied.

gold_actions.business_effect: The partner work order already on the ledger is priced at 327.00 and that amount becomes the cleaning cost on file.

request_binding.action_semantics: A professional cleaning document on the ledger with no cost on file is a partner work order awaiting its rate-card price; the price is owed by the record and is worked out at the level held after the move-down.

discriminator.business_meaning: professional cleaning document on file without a cleaning cost

stage_provenance.fact: The cleaning cost on file is written by this call; the work order itself was put on file on 2026-09-12 before the call.

base_preconditions.condition: Governs evidence totals on file (damage_evidence_update): the totals are brought up to date after a submission while the report is open; no structured gate applies to the totals update itself.

gold_actions.business_effect: The report is approved at Level 3 and 355.20 is charged to the requesting rider; the assessment becomes charged with a fee charge entry of 355.20.

request_binding.action_semantics: The driver's request is the approval of her report; review approval and the charge are one write. It is owed once the level, the photo set and the partner price stand.

discriminator.business_meaning: report under review ready for approval and charge

stage_provenance.fact: The level held lists the incident category (step 9), the photos on file reach the approval photo set (step 11) and the partner work order carries its price (step 13); the approval and charge are performed by this call.

base_preconditions.condition: When a report brings the driver's count to driver_report_review_threshold or more, support may not approve it: it stays with Trust and Safety, and the only support action is a POLICY_NOT_COVERED handoff.
A fee is charged only on an assessment approved at review, once, on approval (charge_timing).
Support may not approve a fee on a Wayfare Shared trip (shared_trip_assessable); those reports go to Trust and Safety.

required_user_inputs.information: Mobile number used to locate and verify the caller
Date of birth as a second verification detail
Which trip and report the call is about (Friday night's Black SUV group ride)
Consent for support to finish the report and charge the rider

seed_consistency.check: Reported 2026-09-12 00:27:45 MDT, 36 minutes after the 2026-09-11 23:51:20 MDT drop-off (inside the 24-hour filing window) on a completed Wayfare Black SUV trip; held at Level 4 with 4 photos (Level 4 minimum 4) and one cleaning_receipt document, so the system opened review; nothing assessed or charged (assessed_fee 0.00, net_fee_billed 0.00); the evidence deadline (48 hours after the report, 2026-09-14 00:27:45 MDT) is still open at frozen_time; the driver's only report in the last 30 days.

Evidence submission of one cleaning_receipt document (the partner work order) on 2026-09-12 13:58:12 MDT while the report was reported, at fee level Level 4; amount 0.00 as for every evidence entry; it is the first of the report's submissions (Level 4 allows 3, Level 3 allows 2).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's profile from the mobile number she states, returning her customer reference number, account role and home market.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed to the driver's customer reference number; the profile is also the target of the identity check.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller as the profile owner with two stated details (mobile number and date of birth).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Account details may not be discussed and no assessment may be changed before identity is verified; two matching details are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the caller's driver services agreement: Wayfare Black SUV Driver Agreement, active, Denver.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Confirms the verified caller is the reporting driver on an active agreement, the agreement the assessment names; the report's driver_agreement_id is this row.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Pull every cleaning or damage assessment reported by this driver: the Level 4 report on the Friday trip with its status, level, incident category, photos on file, cleaning cost on file, assessed fee, reported_at and the requesting rider.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Supplies the target assessment and every assessment field the four computations read (level held vs incident category for the move-down, photo_count for the photo shortfall, repair_receipt_amount for the partner price and fee basis), and the driver's report count in the last 30 days for the report-volume gate on approval.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the assessment ledger: the professional cleaning document (partner work order) put on file on 2026-09-12 with no price, and the absence of any photo submission or fee charge.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The odor component (A1), the partner-price existence and its rush and weekend charges (A3) and the fee basis and lost driving time (A4) are decided from this ledger row and its date.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the reported trip: Wayfare Black SUV, five seats requested, Denver, 36 actual minutes, drop-off 2026-09-11 23:51:20 MDT, requesting rider.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Cabin multiplier, metro add-on, liquid and upholstery add-ons (A1), occupied-seat, liquid and trim close-ups and the core photo count (A2), service basis, extraction, metro rate, rush and conditioning (A3), lost driving time start and vehicle fee cap (A4) all read this trip; it also shows the trip is not Wayfare Shared.

Any agent that reads the trip, the incident category and the ledger converges on 187.00.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Two orders are free: the photo upload (step 11) and the partner pricing (step 13) both depend only on the move-down and both feed the approval. The upload writes a photo_set ledger row and photo_count; the pricing writes repair_receipt_amount. The pricing computation reads only cleaning_receipt rows and the level, the photo computation reads only photo_count, the level and the trip, so neither write changes the other's input. Verified run: pricing before the upload gives 327.00 and the upload after the pricing still gives 5; terminal DB identical either way. The move-down must precede both (their prerequisite sentences) and the approval must follow all three (its three prerequisite sentences).

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the move-down (other gold writes unchanged) leaves the report at Level 4: the approval fee recomputes to 361.92 instead of 355.20 (the Level 4 cap multiple 3.8 x 150.00 no longer binds) and the terminal variant_name and assessed_fee differ.
Skipping the pricing leaves the cleaning cost at 0.00: the approval fee recomputes to 227.52 instead of 355.20 (fee basis falls to the assessed fee 187.00).
Skipping the upload leaves photo_count at 4 and no photo_set ledger row: the terminal assessment and ledger differ from gold, and the approval would be written with the photo set unmet.

Skipping the move-down changes the photos still needed from 7 to 8 (at Level 4 the core is the per-row pair 2 x 3 rows = 6, plus 2 + 2 + 2 close-ups = 12, less 4 on file = 8) and the terminal photo_count from 11 to 12.
Skipping the move-down changes the partner price from 327.00 to 409.50 (Level 4 row price 80.00 x 3 rows) and the terminal repair_receipt_amount accordingly.
